caption: The drawing displays a decorative border or panel design featuring a symmetrical arrangement of ornamental shapes in shades of light brown and reddish-brown. At the center of the design, there is a stylized floral element with a six-petaled flower and curved leaves or scrollwork underneath. Above the flower, there is an arc composed of dotted lines, forming an oval shape that rises to the top and splits into two symmetrical, curling points, each with a small circle at its tip. Smaller curved lines and dots are placed within the interior of the oval. The lower portion of the design contains a geometric border consisting of a horizontal band with interlocking diamond shapes outlined in brown, creating a repeating pattern. The background is a pale beige with soft, horizontal brush strokes, and the composition is framed with a white border.
title: Wall Painting, Restoration Drawing from Reassembled Fragments
